def bpr_sequence_loss(
    model: nn.Module, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor
) -> torch.Tensor:
    if seq.ndim != 2 or pos.shape != seq.shape or neg.shape != seq.shape:
        raise ValueError("Training tensors must share shape B x L")
    valid = (seq != 0) & (pos != 0) & (neg != 0)
    if not bool(valid.any()):
        raise RuntimeError("Training batch contains no valid next-item targets")
    pos_scores, neg_scores = model(seq, pos, neg)
    if pos_scores.shape != seq.shape or neg_scores.shape != seq.shape:
        raise RuntimeError("Training scores must have shape B x L")
    # Index before evaluating the loss: multiplying invalid losses by zero
    # would not remove NaNs. Reduction remains position-weighted BPR.
    return nn.functional.softplus(
        neg_scores[valid] - pos_scores[valid]
    ).mean()
